## Objectives

this cluster covers, as industry-general knowledge, never presented as
capabilities of any CVLN system:

- Foundations of application/network/cloud security.
- Identity & access management (IAM), zero-trust architecture.
- Applied cryptography, vulnerability management, penetration testing.
- SOC operations, digital forensics & incident response (DFIR), threat
  intelligence.
- DevSecOps, compliance (ISO 27001-class frameworks), AI/agent
  security, fintech-specific security engineering.
